name: Kiro powers
desc: Installable packages of framework context and MCP servers agents load on demand.
desc_zh: 可安装的框架上下文与 MCP 服务器包，按需加载到智能体。
solves: Agents guess at framework patterns they were never taught; a power ships the expertise so they stop guessing and start shipping.
solves_zh: 智能体对没学过的框架只能靠猜；power 把专业知识打包给它，让它少猜多交付。
best_for: Your agent keeps mishandling connection pooling for a serverless database and you want the vendor's own patterns loaded.
best_for_zh: 智能体总是搞错 serverless 数据库的连接池，你想把厂商自己的最佳实践直接加载进去时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — kiro.dev blog feed and product directory）。 Missing from the ledger. At launch powers worked in Kiro IDE; the stated direction is to make them work across Kiro CLI, Cline, Cursor and Claude Code. The Model Context Protocol is the transport for the bundled servers. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：powers 是 Kiro IDE 里供智能体按需加载的上下文包，不是 SDK；归入编程智能体，形态与所在产品一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://kiro.dev/blog/introducing-powers/
